name: AISaleBot
author: AI Brain Solutions Ltd. Pte.

sections.description:
AISaleBot is an AI-powered sales chatbot service that helps WordPress and WooCommerce store owners engage visitors, answer product-related questions, and increase conversions automatically.

Why Use AISaleBot on Your Website?

AISaleBot helps WordPress and WooCommerce websites improve customer engagement by combining AI-powered automation with optional human support.

Real-Time Chat Support: Communicate instantly with visitors to answer questions, provide product information, and assist customers during their shopping journey.

AI-Powered Chatbot Automation: Combine automated AI responses with human assistance to handle customer inquiries more efficiently and reduce manual workload.

Automated Customer Support with AIBrain: Let AIBrain, AISaleBot’s AI engine, automatically handle common questions using trained website and product data, helping reduce response time and support effort.

Product-Aware Responses: Provide relevant answers and recommendations based on WooCommerce products, pricing, and configured store information.

Proactive Engagement to Improve Conversions: Engage visitors at the right time by offering assistance, answering pre-sale questions, and guiding users toward relevant products or actions.

Easy Setup with No Coding Required: Get started quickly by connecting your website using a Chatbot ID, without writing any code.

Customizable Chatbot Appearance: Adjust chatbot colors, position, and behavior to match your website design and branding.

Omni-Channel Integration: Manage and extend customer conversations across supported channels such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, Slack, and website live chat through the AISaleBot platform.

Human Handoff Support: Seamlessly transfer conversations from the AI chatbot to a live agent when human assistance is needed.

How It Works

  1. Sign up for an AISaleBot account at https://aisalebot.io/signup?platform=wordpress
  2. Install and activate this plugin on your WordPress site
  3. Connect your site using your AISaleBot Chatbot ID
  4. The AI chatbot widget will appear on your website and handle customer conversations automatically

Third Party Services

This is a Service-Based Plugin

AISaleBot is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) chatbot platform. This plugin acts as an integration layer that connects your WordPress site to the AISaleBot cloud service. Unlike traditional plugins that run entirely on your server, AISaleBot requires continuous connection to our external servers to provide AI-powered chatbot functionality.

This plugin relies on external services provided by AI Brain Solution to deliver chatbot functionality. By using this plugin, you acknowledge that data will be transmitted to these external services.

AISaleBot External Service and Data Usage

  • AISaleBot is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) chatbot platform provided by AI Brain Solution, and this plugin functions as an integration layer between your WordPress site and the AISaleBot cloud service. The plugin requires an active connection to external AISaleBot servers in order to deliver AI-powered chatbot functionality.

  • Data is transmitted to AISaleBot servers when the chatbot widget is loaded on your website, when visitors interact with the chatbot by sending messages or asking questions, and when you configure chatbot or product data in the AISaleBot dashboard. Configuration actions may include providing your website URL for automatic content or product crawling, or manually uploading content and product information.

  • The data transmitted may include chatbot configuration and settings, user messages and conversation history, product-related information such as names, prices, and descriptions when configured in the AISaleBot dashboard, as well as basic website context including URL and page information. This data is used solely to generate AI-powered responses and provide chatbot services.

  • To use this plugin, you are required to create an account with AISaleBot at https://aisalebot.io/signup?platform=wordpress and obtain a valid Chatbot ID. All chatbot conversations are processed on AISaleBot servers to generate automated responses. No personal data is collected without direct user interaction with the chatbot, and all conversation data is stored securely in accordance with applicable data protection standards.

Legal information regarding the use of AISaleBot services is available in the Terms of Service at https://aisalebot.io/terms-of-service and the Privacy Policy at https://aisalebot.io/privacy-policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aisalebot folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Create an account at https://aisalebot.io if you haven’t already.
  4. Go to AISaleBot in the WordPress Admin menu.
  5. Enter your Chatbot ID from your AISaleBot dashboard.
  6. Configure your chatbot settings and enable it to display on your website.
sections.faq:
Does AISaleBot work without WooCommerce?

Yes. AISaleBot works on any WordPress site. WooCommerce integration enhances product recommendations but is optional.

Is coding required to use this plugin?

No. All configuration is done through the WordPress admin dashboard.

Does this plugin collect personal data?

AISaleBot processes user messages only when users interact with the chatbot to generate AI responses. Conversation data is sent to AISaleBot servers for processing. Please review our privacy policy at https://aisalebot.io/privacy-policy for details.

Do I need an account to use this plugin?

Yes. You need to sign up for a free account at https://aisalebot.io/signup?platform=wordpress to obtain a Chatbot ID.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. AISaleBot offers a free trial plan. Visit https://aisalebot.io/pricing for pricing details.

Why does the chatbot load from an external server?

The chatbot widget is loaded from our servers to provide real-time AI processing, automatic feature updates, and ensure optimal performance without requiring plugin updates.

What happens to conversation data?

All conversations are processed and stored securely on AISaleBot servers to provide AI responses and improve service quality. Data is not shared with third parties except as described in our privacy policy.
